_comment: repo -> what it actually runs on this mini. Measured from `docker ps` and
~/caddyfile on 2026-08-17, not assumed. Update when a stack moves.
Used by verify.py to answer the only question that matters after a merge:
is the thing this repo serves still up, and is it running the code we
just merged, or the old image?

lxrbckl-labs/reactive-resume.notes: Two tenants share one image. msymmonds tenant was spun down; its Caddy block is stale.

lxrbckl-labs/Project-FlyingGitman.notes: No published port and no Caddy site block — container-health only.

lxrbckl-labs/Project-Showalter.notes: Reports UNHEALTHY and has for weeks — pre-existing, see OPEN-ITEMS. Don't attribute it to a dependency merge.

lxrbckl-labs/Project-ASBC.notes: Not deployed on the mini. No CI, no tests, no container — POLICY forbids merging here regardless.

lxrbckl-labs/Project-RCoD.notes: Not deployed on the mini. Same as ASBC.

lxrbckl-labs/Project-DS.notes: MCP server only. Published on :4000 with no Caddy site block, so container-health only (same shape as Project-FlyingGitman). apps/web is NOT deployed on this mini as of 2026-08-23 - no container, no Caddy block - so a days-behind number here measures the MCP image alone. project-ds-postgres-1 is its database, deliberately not listed: it runs postgres:17-alpine, not an image this repo builds.
